<script>
(() => {
  const adminAjaxUrl = "https:\/\/thetopsecretcomedyclub.co.uk\/wp-admin\/admin-ajax.php";

  const getComedianIds = (eventLi) => {
    const raw = eventLi.dataset.eventComedians;
    if (!raw) return null;
    try {
      const ids = JSON.parse(raw);
      return Array.isArray(ids)
        ? ids.map(n => parseInt(n, 10)).filter(Number.isFinite)
        : null;
    } catch {
      console.warn('Invalid data-event-comedians JSON:', raw);
      return null;
    }
  };

  const fetchComedianMarkup = async (comedianId, mcId) => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    params.append('action', 'jw_get_comedian');
    params.append('comedian_id', String(comedianId));
    if (mcId) params.append('mc_id', String(mcId));

    const res = await fetch(adminAjaxUrl, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8' },
      body: params.toString(),
      credentials: 'same-origin',
    });

    const text = await res.text();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`jw_get_comedian failed (${res.status}): ${text.slice(0, 120)}`);
    return text;
  };

  const hydrateEvent = async (eventLi) => {
    // Make sure we’re hydrating the right LI
    if (!eventLi.classList.contains('event--item')) return;

    // Prevent double hydration
    if (eventLi.dataset.comediansHydrated === '1') return;
    eventLi.dataset.comediansHydrated = '1';

    const ids = getComedianIds(eventLi);
    if (!ids || !ids.length) {
      console.log('No comedian IDs for event', eventLi);
      return;
    }

    const container = eventLi.querySelector(':scope .comedians__list'); // :scope avoids weird nested matches
    if (!container) {
      console.error('No .comedians__list found inside event LI', eventLi);
      return;
    }

    const mcId = eventLi.getAttribute('data-event-mc') || '';

    console.log('Hydrating event', { ids, mcId, container });

    // Append as each response comes back (much easier to verify)
    for (const id of ids) {
      try {
        const html = await fetchComedianMarkup(id, mcId);

        // Debug: prove insertion is happening
        const before = container.childElementCount;
        container.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html);
        const after = container.childElementCount;

        console.log(`Inserted comedian ${id} into event`, { before, after });

      } catch (e) {
        console.error('Failed to hydrate comedian', id, e);
      }
    }
  };

  const hydrateAll = async () => {
    const list = document.querySelector('#events-container');
    if (!list) return;

    const items = [...list.querySelectorAll('li.event--item')];
    console.log('Found events to hydrate:', items.length);

    for (const li of items) {
      await hydrateEvent(li);
    }

    // Sanity check: if something wipes the DOM after hydration, you’ll see it
    setTimeout(() => {
      const totalComedians = document.querySelectorAll('#events-container .comedians__list > li').length;
      console.log('Total hydrated comedian <li> in DOM after 1s:', totalComedians);
    }, 1000);
  };

  // Run after everything else has had a chance to render/replace the events list
  window.addEventListener('load', hydrateAll);
})();
</script>

<p>We work tirelessly to book the best most varied stand-up comedy lineups. We have created the most intimate, atmospheric and exciting comedy club by developing and improving the space for the precise purpose of hosting stand-up comedy.</p>

<p>Come and discover why we are the most loved Comedy Club in New York, by audiences and comedians.</p>

<p>We are supported by some of the U.S.A.s best and most successful stand-up comedians. Household names regularly drop in, to soak up the atmosphere and work on new material or practice sets for T.V. or Tours. Alongside our dangerously inexpensive bar, all this adds up to explain why we have the highest-rated comedy club in the U.S. on Trip Advisor and on Google Reviews, please take a look at what the people who have visited the Club and have experienced shows have to say on TripAdvisor or Google.</p>

<p>We want to entertain and surprise you in the right way, not rip you off! That’s why we keep our prices as low as we possibly can and our quality equally as high.</p>

<p>Please book early as more and more of our shows are selling out.</p>

<p>We would like everyone to come and experience what we put together every day of the year. (minus Christmas day and Sunday's.) We Look forward to seeing you soon and enjoying our stand-up comedy together with us.</p>

            var errorNoResults = "<p class='small -error'>No results found. Please try again using a different search term</p>";

                    if(this.response){
                        datafetch.innerHTML = this.response;
                        datafetch.classList.add('-open-results');
                        datafetch.style = "overflow: scroll";
                    } else {
                        datafetch.innerHTML = errorEmpty;
                    }

                    if(!this.response){
                        datafetch.innerHTML = errorNoResults;

                }

            function tabs() {
                console.log("TABS footer script run...");

                const tabsContainer = Array.from(
                    document.querySelectorAll(".tabs-container")
                );

                if (!tabsContainer) {
                    return;
                }

                tabsContainer.forEach((tabContainer) => {
                    const tabsTab = Array.from(tabContainer.querySelectorAll(".tabs-tab"));

                    const contentAreas = Array.from(
                        tabContainer.querySelectorAll(".tabs-content")
                    );


                    tabsTab.forEach((tab) => {
                        //setTabBasedOnUrlHash(tab);

                        tab.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
                            e.cancelBubble = true;

                            tabsTab.forEach((tab) => {
                                tab.classList.remove("-current");
                            });

                            tab.classList.add("-current");

                            const dataTab = tab.getAttribute("data-tab");

                            console.log('TAB', dataTab);

                            const tabTarget = tabContainer.querySelector(
                                '.tabs-content[data-tab="' + dataTab + '"]'
                            );
                            contentAreas.forEach((contentArea) => {
                                contentArea.classList.remove("-show");
                            });
                            tabTarget.classList.add("-show");

                            if(window.fullCal) {
                                console.log('calendar added')

                            }

<script>
(() => {
  const adminAjaxUrl = "https:\/\/thetopsecretcomedyclub.co.uk\/wp-admin\/admin-ajax.php";

  const getComedianIds = (eventLi) => {
    const raw = eventLi.dataset.eventComedians;
    if (!raw) return null;
    try {
      const ids = JSON.parse(raw);
      return Array.isArray(ids)
        ? ids.map(n => parseInt(n, 10)).filter(Number.isFinite)
        : null;
    } catch {
      console.warn('Invalid data-event-comedians JSON:', raw);
      return null;
    }
  };

  const fetchComedianMarkup = async (comedianId, mcId) => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    params.append('action', 'jw_get_comedian');
    params.append('comedian_id', String(comedianId));
    if (mcId) params.append('mc_id', String(mcId));

    const res = await fetch(adminAjaxUrl, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8' },
      body: params.toString(),
      credentials: 'same-origin',
    });

    const text = await res.text();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`jw_get_comedian failed (${res.status}): ${text.slice(0, 120)}`);
    return text;
  };

  const hydrateEvent = async (eventLi) => {
    // Make sure we’re hydrating the right LI
    if (!eventLi.classList.contains('event--item')) return;

    // Prevent double hydration
    if (eventLi.dataset.comediansHydrated === '1') return;
    eventLi.dataset.comediansHydrated = '1';

    const ids = getComedianIds(eventLi);
    if (!ids || !ids.length) {
      console.log('No comedian IDs for event', eventLi);
      return;
    }

    const container = eventLi.querySelector(':scope .comedians__list'); // :scope avoids weird nested matches
    if (!container) {
      console.error('No .comedians__list found inside event LI', eventLi);
      return;
    }

    const mcId = eventLi.getAttribute('data-event-mc') || '';

    console.log('Hydrating event', { ids, mcId, container });

    // Append as each response comes back (much easier to verify)
    for (const id of ids) {
      try {
        const html = await fetchComedianMarkup(id, mcId);

        // Debug: prove insertion is happening
        const before = container.childElementCount;
        container.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html);
        const after = container.childElementCount;

        console.log(`Inserted comedian ${id} into event`, { before, after });

      } catch (e) {
        console.error('Failed to hydrate comedian', id, e);
      }
    }
  };

  const hydrateAll = async () => {
    const list = document.querySelector('#events-container');
    if (!list) return;

    const items = [...list.querySelectorAll('li.event--item')];
    console.log('Found events to hydrate:', items.length);

    for (const li of items) {
      await hydrateEvent(li);
    }

    // Sanity check: if something wipes the DOM after hydration, you’ll see it
    setTimeout(() => {
      const totalComedians = document.querySelectorAll('#events-container .comedians__list > li').length;
      console.log('Total hydrated comedian <li> in DOM after 1s:', totalComedians);
    }, 1000);
  };

  // Run after everything else has had a chance to render/replace the events list
  window.addEventListener('load', hydrateAll);
})();
</script>

        <script type="text/javascript">
        function fetchSearchResults(event){
            event.preventDefault();
            //check that input#keyword has a value before making post request
            var formInputVal = document.getElementById('keyword').value;
            var datafetch = document.getElementById('datafetch');
            var errorNoResults = "<p class='small -error'>No results found. Please try again using a different search term</p>";
            var errorEmpty = "<p class='small -error'>Please enter a search term and try again</p>";

            if (/^\s*$/.test(formInputVal)){
                //value is either empty or contains whitespace characters
                datafetch.innerHTML = errorEmpty;
                return;
            }

            let xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
            //xhr.open('POST', '<!?php echo get_admin_url(1, 'admin-ajax.php'); ?>', true);
            xhr.open('POST', 'https://thetopsecretcomedyclub.co.uk/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php', true);
            xhr.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded;');
            xhr.onload = function () {
                if (this.status >= 200 && this.status < 400) {
                    if(this.response){
                        datafetch.innerHTML = this.response;
                        datafetch.classList.add('-open-results');
                        datafetch.style = "overflow: scroll";
                    } else {
                        datafetch.innerHTML = errorEmpty;
                    }

                    if(!this.response){
                        datafetch.innerHTML = errorNoResults;
                    }

                } else {
                    // If fail
                    console.log('search fail', this.response);
                }
            };
            xhr.onerror = function() {
                // Connection error
                console.log('search fail!', this.response);
            };

            xhr.send('action=data_fetch&keyword=' + document.getElementById('keyword').value)

        }
        var searchClose = document.querySelector(".js-search-results__close");

        if(searchClose){
            searchClose.addEventListener('click', function() {
                console.log('Search closed')
                const resultsContainer = document.querySelector('.search_result');
                if(resultsContainer) {
                    resultsContainer.classList.remove('-open-results');
                }
            });
        }

    </script>

        <script>
            function tabs() {
                console.log("TABS footer script run...");

                const tabsContainer = Array.from(
                    document.querySelectorAll(".tabs-container")
                );

                if (!tabsContainer) {
                    return;
                }

                tabsContainer.forEach((tabContainer) => {
                    const tabsTab = Array.from(tabContainer.querySelectorAll(".tabs-tab"));

                    const contentAreas = Array.from(
                        tabContainer.querySelectorAll(".tabs-content")
                    );


                    tabsTab.forEach((tab) => {
                        //setTabBasedOnUrlHash(tab);

                        tab.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
                            e.cancelBubble = true;

                            tabsTab.forEach((tab) => {
                                tab.classList.remove("-current");
                            });

                            tab.classList.add("-current");

                            const dataTab = tab.getAttribute("data-tab");

                            console.log('TAB', dataTab);

                            const tabTarget = tabContainer.querySelector(
                                '.tabs-content[data-tab="' + dataTab + '"]'
                            );
                            contentAreas.forEach((contentArea) => {
                                contentArea.classList.remove("-show");
                            });
                            tabTarget.classList.add("-show");

                            if(window.fullCal) {
                                console.log('calendar added')
                                window.fullCal.render();
                            }

                        });
                    }); // end foreach
                });
            }
            window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
                tabs();
            })
